name: serverless-ledger-monorepo
description: 账盾 - 基于 React + Capacitor/Tauri + WebDAV 加密快照同步的去中心化纯本地优先个人财务应用

scripts.build: npm -w @ledger/shared run build && npm -w @ledger/client run build
scripts.build:client: npm -w @ledger/shared run build && npm -w @ledger/client run build
scripts.test: npm -w @ledger/shared test && node scripts/verify-crypto.mjs && node scripts/test-client-sync-adapter.mjs && node scripts/test-local-store.mjs && node scripts/verify-bugfixes.mjs && node scripts/verify-build-pipeline.mjs
